This plot is rented, so I do not want to spend too much on it — the landlord takes part of the harvest and I cannot be sure I will keep renting it next year. I will put a little DAP at planting since the cooperative gives it on credit, but only a small amount, and I will add some manure from my cattle to save money. I will use my own saved seed like always, and rely on my family for most of the work, hiring just a few people for weeding and harvest since 0.64 ha of "other" crop is manageable.
